title: Implement preview page (/preview/[slug])
description: Implement the preview page that renders the generated landing page inside an iframe-like full-page preview. Shows the prospect's site exactly as it will be exported.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows the full landing page generated for the prospect
Uses the section renderer (TASK-38) to render all sections
Top bar shows prospect name, 'Edit' and 'Export' buttons
Returns 404 if prospect not found or not ready
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Server component. Load prospect by slug. If not found or status != 'ready', show 404-style error. Parse page_data. Render with a thin admin top bar and the full landing page content below.

Fixed top bar: prospect business name, 'Back to Batch' link, 'Edit' button (/edit/[slug]), 'Export' button (triggers POST /api/export/[slug]). Use a semi-transparent overlay bar that doesn't affect layout.
Import and render the SectionRenderer (TASK-38) with the page_data sections. Apply the assigned palette's CSS variables. Full-width, no admin sidebar.
Take Playwright screenshot of /preview/[slug] for a generated prospect. Verify all sections render with content and images.
